verified_findings.claim: The cited edition is the 1905 second half of volume V, covering 1536-1540.
verified_findings.evidence: Historischer Verein St. Gallen publication catalogue lists Vadianische Briefsammlung V, 2. Hälfte: 1536-1540, 1905, 476 pages.

verified_findings.claim: HBBW letter 875 (Bullinger to Vadian, 1536-08-06) explicitly cites Vadian BW V p.339.
verified_findings.evidence: Editorial note states Vadian was apparently prepared to submit his Aphorismen to Bucer after Bucer regretted not having seen them before printing; the note cites Vadian BW V 339.

verified_findings.claim: The p.339 item therefore belongs directly to the immediate 1536 Eucharistic-concord context and is not merely a later secondary recollection.
verified_findings.evidence: HBBW 875 is dated 1536-08-06 and discusses sending Vadian's Aphorismen to Strasbourg, explicitly anchoring its editorial note to Vadian BW V 339.

verified_findings.claim: The Vadianische Briefsammlung archive now has modern digital cataloguing paths with links to digitized letters and edition extracts for already edited correspondence.
verified_findings.evidence: Stadtarchiv St. Gallen states that digital catalog records are being created in swisscollections and the St. Gallen library network, including links to digitized letters and edition extracts.
